description: Convy helps households manage shared shopping lists and tasks directly from ChatGPT. Users can inspect household context, view shopping and task lists, open compact visual panels on request, add multiple shopping items, create tasks, and mark existing items or tasks as completed or pending. All write actions are limited to the user's private Convy household data and require confirmation.
